profileRegistration.basis: Existing V14 carrier() anchor coordinates from planetArrivalArt.ts; unchanged. Pivot is original full canvas center.

measurementMethod.colorPredicate: alpha>=128 and red>140 and green>75 and red-blue>45, evaluated in original decoded source pixels without modifying them.
measurementMethod.components: 4-connected components. Aft registration uses the equal mean of centers of the three largest components with center.x<500; nose uses the largest component with center.x>1100. Every selected component was checked against the separately opened source art.
measurementMethod.componentCenter: Midpoint of pixel-center bounds: (min+maxExclusive-1)/2 for each axis. This is a reproducible visual landmark, not an exact physical nozzle center.
measurementMethod.registeredPoints: Transport all four unchanged historical profile points by the similarity from the measured profile rear-triad mean to the front warm detail onto the corresponding candidate axis. This preserves small offsets already present in the profile anchors.
measurementMethod.precision: Subpixel decimals encode the deterministic calculations, not subpixel artistic certainty.
measurementMethod.pivot: Derived registration pivot preserving full profile canvas center, not center of mass.
measurementMethod.release: Derived from unchanged profile release(850,702); not a newly identified bay or contact point. Real release/contact must keep the established profile.
measurementMethod.aspect: All reference and candidate canvases are native1536×1024. No pixel resize, padding or coordinate pre-stretch.
measurementMethod.engines: Three luminous mouths are part of the source art. All runtime exhaustVisibility values remain0, review unreviewed; no additional emission resources or sockets approved.
